summary: Sprint 0B Phase 2 retest — CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED. All 7 acceptance checks + edge case now PASS. User's manual cover on 3rd photo now persists across Vera Studio re-processing (previously reverted to index 0). Fix in useVeraStudio.ts (capture userCoverId from photosRef at start of runProcessing and reapply after pipeline) is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: useVeraStudio.ts L43-45: fix correctly reads userCoverId from photosRef.current at pipeline start, then reapplies it in the final map only if the photo still exists. Handles edge case (user's cover removed) correctly — Vera's suggestedCoverIndex takes over.

userChoseCoverRef never resets to false. Not user-observable now (because coverStillExists guard prevents stale lock when cover was removed), but the ref is functionally dead-weight once set. Consider resetting when the covered photo is removed for cleaner state.

runProcessing captures userCoverId from photosRef at start; if the user changes the cover WHILE processing runs (still ~4.5s window), the mid-pipeline click will be overwritten by the captured earlier value at pipeline end. Low probability, but a small race condition worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline is ~4.5s (5 stages × 900ms), wait 6.5s after each upload. File input has hidden attribute — use wait_for_selector state='attached'. Photo ids contain dots (from filename img3.png) → CSS selectors MUST quote the value: [data-testid="photo-<id>"]. drag_to on locators works reliably for DnD reorder.
